director.text: eight ninths
Haan, sahi: 8/9 bada hai, kyunki usmein kami 1/9 hai, aur 1/9, 1/7 se chhoti hai. Ab 5/6 aur 7/8 mein bada kaunsa hai?
pehle wale step se pata chala
Haan, wahi tareeka: dono poore se ek-ek hissa kam hain. Kami 1/6 ya 1/8? Jiski kami chhoti, wahi bhinn bada.
shayad gin ke

Haan, ginkar bhi dekh sakte ho: 1/8, 1/6 se chhota hai, isliye 7/8 bada hai. Aaj tumne same numerator, same denominator, aur 1 ke paas wali fractions compare karne ke tareeke lagaye. Shabash Riya, alvida!
